items.question: How do I remove background from an image?
items.answer: Upload a supported image, sign in when prompted, run background removal, and download the finished PNG.

items.question: Can the result stay transparent?
items.answer: Yes. Keep the transparent option selected when preparing the PNG for download.

items.question: Can I choose a background color?
items.answer: Yes. The result controls let you select a preset or custom color before downloading.
